text:
Emma (Customer): hi team — after last night's model quantization deploy our account started showing objects expiring much earlier than expected, lots of customers complaining. noticed a bunch of deletes between 02:12-02:20 UTC. can you confirm? :worried:
Priya (Support): sorry to hear that — can you paste one example object id and a request id from the timeframe? we'll start a preservation hold immediately.
Emma (Customer): obj_id: 6f8c2b9e, request_id from the API: req_e4d2a1f7. TTL on the object shows 7d remaining even though our policy is 90d.
Priya (Support): thanks. putting a temporary preserve flag and creating internal escalation to Security & SRE.
DeployBot: deploy rtx-quantize-v2 completed by @ava at 2026-03-17T01:58:42Z (sha: a1b2c3). no rollback recorded.
Daniel (SRE): pulling logs for req_e4d2a1f7 — saw config eval at 01:59:12 UTC that reads `default_retention_days=7` for the tenant. prior value was `90`.
Ava (Eng-ML): that sounds like the migration script we ran to support quantized checkpoints altered a config template. I'm checking the deploy manifest now.
Daniel (SRE): quick snippet from config diff (01:58:59):
```
- retention: { default_days: 90, preserve_by_default: true }
+ retention: { default_days: 7, preserve_by_default: true }
```
Marcus (Security): :warning: this is an integrity/compliance incident. we need: 1) full list of impacted tenants, 2) the time window, 3) evidence that no KMS/HSM keys were rotated/deleted. escalate to Legal.
Priya (Support): already doing. collecting list now. Emma can you confirm whether you use customer-managed keys (CMK) or our default KMS?
Emma (Customer): we use CMK (customer-managed). no KMS alerts on our side.
Daniel (SRE): verified: KMS key usage for the tenant shows no rotations between 00:00-04:00 UTC. HSM module logs are clean. this looks like a config value flip during template rendering, not key-level data loss.
Ava (Eng-ML): root cause appears to be a templating bug in the quantization deploy where an uninitialized variable `quant_retention_days` defaults to `7` and overwrote `default_retention_days` in the tenant manifest. reproducing locally now.
Priya (Support): action items: 1) immediate preserve on impacted objects (done), 2) snapshot exports for Legal, 3) rollback config to 90d and redeploy, 4) postmortem + customer comms.
Legal Team: we need a forensic export of all objects with TTL changes and a timeline (when TTL changed, which user/process initiated). please include signed checksums.
Daniel (SRE): starting export job: `support/export --tenant=emma-co --since=2026-03-17T01:50Z --until=2026-03-17T02:30Z --filter="ttl_changed"` — job id `exp_7821`. attaching incremental audit log.
Priya (Support): ETA on full list of impacted tenants?
Daniel (SRE): running a query across the retention table; preliminary shows ~18 tenants impacted in prod region us-west-2 (most are small). rough list inbound in 12–18 min.
Ava (Eng-ML): hotfix ready to restore the template variable default to 90. deploying to a canary tenant now. will monitor for any further unintended retention flips.
Marcus (Security): also add an automated check in the deploy pipeline: fail if `default_retention_days < 30` unless explicit override by a tenant admin. this prevents accidental low defaults.
Priya (Support): customer update sent: "we have applied a preservation hold and are investigating; exports and timeline will be provided within 24 hours."
Emma (Customer): thanks — please cc our legal contact: legal@emma-co.com. need to confirm no data was permanently purged.
Daniel (SRE): quick status: canary revert applied, canary manifests now show `default_retention_days=90`. no new TTL flips. rolling fix to prod starting 02:30 UTC.
DeployBot: deploy rtx-quantize-v2-hotfix started by @ava at 2026-03-17T02:32:10Z.
Priya (Support): created ticket SUP-33218 and linked to incident INC-2026-0317-quantize-retention. adding Legal & Security as watchers.
Legal Team: also prepare a disclosure statement draft for Emma's customers; coordinate with Support on language.
Marcus (Security): verify audit logs include who triggered the migration job; we need to know whether this was automated or manual.
Ava (Eng-ML): migration job is automated as part of the quantize release; the bug was in a handlebars template where `{{quant_retention_days}}` wasn't present for some tenants. patch queued.
Daniel (SRE): export job `exp_7821` completed (partial): 4,312 objects flagged with TTL change; checksum file uploaded to secure bucket `inc-2026-0317-exports/exp_7821-checksums.txt`.
Priya (Support): next steps: share export and timeline with Legal, restore any objects that were tombstoned if backups available, confirm with customer when rollback completes.
Emma (Customer): appreciate the quick response. please let me know once rollback is fully applied and provide the export link.
Priya (Support): will follow up. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
